spec.description: Thermotec 4-Zero is an Australian-made, fire retardant closed-cell polyethylene foam pipe insulation with excellent thermal resistance and energy efficiency, suitable for various applications including hospitals, commercial buildings, and luxury accommodations.
features: Heat laminated, factory fitted, reinforced aluminium foil face
Higher density foam for longevity and durability
Low installed cost – Maximum energy savings
Resistant to moisture with high vapour resistance - anti-microbial
Resistant to hydrocarbons and most chemicals
Green Star compliant – low VOC and zero ozone depleting substances

technical.value: Excellent - resists most common acids/chemicals, including oils

spec.sustainability: Low V.O.C. Green Building Council & GreenStar compliant, ODP-EMI9, Zero contribution to 'Global Warming Potential', Reuse-Reduce-Recycle
install: Installed around the pipe work surface as tightly as possible without gaps
Edges and ends tightly butted together
All joints and foil overlaps taped using a 48mm wide 4-Zero rated pressure sensitive adhesive aluminium foil tape
Preformed sections cut and mitred for a tight fit around elbows and at tees
Pipe insulation butted tightly up to spacer blocks and sealed using a silicon sealant
limitations: Pipe insulation shall have a wall thickness of either 15mm, 20mm, 25mm, 30mm, 38mm or 50mm
Pipe insulation shall be Australian made Thermotec 4-Zero, fire retardant closed cell polyethylene foam, having a density of not less than 40kg/m3
Pipe insulation shall comply with the requirements of the National Construction Code of Australia in accordance with AS/NZS4859.1, AS3500.4 and tested to AS/NZS1530.3
